ticker_news.title: Why Is Berkshire Hathaway Hoarding Cash?
ticker_news.description: The article discusses Berkshire Hathaway's record cash pile, Chipotle's declining comparable sales, and the impact of export controls on AMD's chip sales to China. It also covers the potential benefits for AMD of manufacturing chips in the US.
ticker_news.author: Ricky Mulvey, Matt Argersinger, Mary Long, Asit Sharma

ticker_news.title: Congress’s May Stock Trades: What They Know That You Don’t
ticker_news.description: Congress members made numerous stock trades in May, with Representative Marjorie Taylor Greene and Representative Robert Bresnahan being the most active traders. Notable trades include buying Texas Instruments, Advanced Micro Devices, and UnitedHealth Group.
ticker_news.author: Marketbeat.Com
